code: project <- mm_project(   slug           = "uds",   outcome        = "event",   predictors     = c("age", "bmi", "sex", "prior_uti", "indication"),   positive_class = 1,   cohort         = cohort$data,   split_var      = "year",   split_at       = 2023,   cluster_id     = "pid",   seed           = 1978 )  project #> <mm_project: uds> #>   outcome    event (event = 1) #>   predictors 5: age, bmi, sex, prior_uti, indication #>   split      year < 2023 develops, the rest is held out #>   cluster    pid #>   seed       1978 mm_project("uds", "event", c("age", "event")) #> Error: #> ! `outcome` (event) is also in `predictors`. A model given its own outcome reports perfect discrimination.  mm_project("uds", "event", c("age", "bmi"), split_var = "year") #> Error: #> ! `split_var` and `split_at` go together. Temporal validation without a time field does not describe a split.  mm_project("uds", "event", c("age", "bmi"),            positive_class = "yes", cohort = cohort$data) #> Error: #> ! `positive_class` (yes) is not an observed value of `event`. Observed: 0, 1. An inverted positive class inverts every reported risk.
